en.s: Maxentius was proclaimed emperor in Rome. His seizure of power challenged the system of imperial rule established under the Tetrarchy.

zh.t: 马克森提乌斯被拥立为皇帝
zh.s: 马克森提乌斯在罗马被拥立为皇帝。他夺取政权，挑战了四帝共治制度下确立的帝国统治体系。

en.s: The Battle of the Milvian Bridge took place between the Roman Emperors Constantine I and Maxentius on 28 October AD 312. It takes its name from the Milvian Bridge, an important route over the Tiber. Constantine won the battle and started on the path that led him to end the Tetrarchy and become the sole ruler of the Roman Empire.

zh.s: 米尔维安桥战役于公元312年10月28日在罗马皇帝君士坦丁一世与马克森提乌斯之间爆发。战役以台伯河上的重要通道米尔维安桥命名。君士坦丁获胜，并由此走上终结四帝共治、成为罗马帝国唯一统治者的道路。

en.s: The siege of Antioch in 968–969 was a successful military offensive undertaken by leading commanders of the Byzantine Empire in order to reconquer the strategically important city of Antioch from the Hamdanid Dynasty.

en.s: The Battle of Vega de Pagana (Winter, 1339) took place between forces loyal to King Alfonso XI of Castile against those mainly of the Marinid sultan Abu al-Hasan 'Ali.

zh.s: 维加德帕加纳之战（1339年冬）是卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十一世的支持者与主要由马林王朝苏丹阿布·哈桑·阿里统率的军队之间的战斗。

en.s: The Reims campaign took place during the Hundred Years' War. It occurred after the French de facto government rejected the terms of the Treaty of London and consequently Edward III of England organised and commanded an expeditionary army to gain by force what he had failed to win by diplomacy. On 28 October 1359 Edward landed at Calais, and advanced to Reims, where he hoped to be crowned king of France.

zh.s: 兰斯战役发生在百年战争期间。法国事实上的政府拒绝《伦敦条约》条款后，英格兰国王爱德华三世组织并指挥远征军，试图以武力夺取未能通过外交手段获得的领土。1359年10月28日，爱德华在加来登陆，随后向兰斯进军，希望在那里加冕为法国国王。

en.t: Christian I is crowned king of Denmark
en.s: Christian I (Christiern; February 1426 – 21 May 1481) was a German noble and Scandinavian monarch under the Kalmar Union. He was king of Denmark (1448–1481), Norway (1450–1481) and Sweden (1457–1464). From 1460 to 1481, he was also duke of Schleswig (within Denmark) and count (after 1474, duke) of Holstein (within the Holy Roman Empire). He was the first king of the House of Oldenburg.

zh.t: 克里斯蒂安一世加冕为丹麦国王
zh.s: 克里斯蒂安一世（又名克里斯蒂恩；1426年2月—1481年5月21日）是德国贵族，也是卡尔马联盟时期的斯堪的纳维亚君主。他于1448年至1481年担任丹麦国王，1450年至1481年担任挪威国王，1457年至1464年担任瑞典国王。1460年至1481年间，他还担任石勒苏益格公爵（该地当时属丹麦）和荷尔斯泰因伯爵（1474年后为公爵，该地属神圣罗马帝国）。他是奥尔登堡王朝的首位国王。

en.t: Ladislaus the Posthumous is crowned king of Bohemia in Prague
en.s: Ladislaus the Posthumous, known as Ladislaus V (Hungarian: Utószülött László; Croatian: Ladislav Posmrtni; Czech: Ladislav Pohrobek; German: Ladislaus Postumus; 22 February 1440 – 23 November 1457), was Duke of Austria and King of Hungary, Croatia and Bohemia. He was the posthumous son of Albert II of Germany with Elizabeth of Luxembourg. Albert had bequeathed all his realms to his future son on his deathbed, but only the estates of Austria accepted his last will.

zh.t: 拉迪斯劳斯五世在布拉格加冕为波希米亚国王
zh.s: 拉迪斯劳斯死后被称为拉迪斯劳斯五世（匈牙利语：Utószülött László；克罗地亚语：Ladislav Posmrtni；捷克语：Ladislav Pohrobek；德语：Ladislaus Postumus；1440年2月22日—1457年11月23日），是奥地利公爵以及匈牙利、克罗地亚和波希米亚国王。他是德国国王阿尔布雷希特二世与卢森堡的伊丽莎白所生的遗腹子。阿尔布雷希特临终时将所有领地遗赠给尚未出生的儿子，但只有奥地利各领地接受了他的遗嘱。

en.s: The Battle of Kashar (Albanian: Beteja e Kasharit) occurred on 28 October 1465 near the village of Kashar, near today's Tirana, between the Albanian-resistance forces of the League of Lezhë led by Skanderbeg and the Ottoman army led by Jakup Arnauti, during the campaign of Ballaban Badera. Jakup Arnauti and his force initially expected to "meet-up" with his fellow general Ballaban; however, he encountered Skanderbeg's army, leading to the ensuing battle.

zh.s: 卡沙尔战役于1465年10月28日在阿尔巴尼亚卡沙尔村附近、今地拉那一带发生。莱热联盟的阿尔巴尼亚抵抗力量由斯坎德培率领，与雅库普·阿尔瑙蒂指挥的奥斯曼军队交战。当时正值巴拉班·巴德拉的军事行动期间。雅库普·阿尔瑙蒂原本打算与同僚将领巴拉班会合，却遇上斯坎德培的军队，战斗由此爆发。

en.s: The Battle of Brustem was fought on 28 October 1467 in Brustem, near Sint-Truiden (present-day Belgium) between the Burgundian State and the Prince-Bishopric of Liège, as part of the Second Liège War.

zh.s: 布鲁斯特姆战役于1467年10月28日在布鲁斯特姆、今比利时圣特赖登附近发生，是第二次列日战争的一部分，交战双方为勃艮第公国和列日采邑主教国。

en.s: The Battle of Yaunis Khan, also known as the Battle of Khan Yunis (Turkish: Han Yunus Muharebesi), was fought on October 28, 1516, between the Ottoman Empire and the Mamluk Sultanate. The Mamluk cavalry forces led by Janbirdi al-Ghazali attacked the Ottomans that were trying to cross Gaza on their way to Egypt. The Ottomans, led by Grand Vizier Hadım Sinan Pasha, were able to break the Egyptian Mamluk cavalry charge.

zh.s: 亚乌尼斯汗战役又称汗尤尼斯战役（土耳其语：Han Yunus Muharebesi），于1516年10月28日在奥斯曼帝国与马穆鲁克苏丹国之间爆发。詹比尔迪·加扎利率领的马穆鲁克骑兵袭击正试图穿过加沙、前往埃及的奥斯曼军队。哈迪姆·锡南帕夏大维齐尔率领的奥斯曼军队成功击退马穆鲁克骑兵冲锋。

en.s: The Battle of Amba Sel was fought on 28 October 1531, between the Ethiopians under their Emperor Dawit II, and the forces of Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi of the Adal Sultanate.

zh.s: 安巴塞尔战役于1531年10月28日爆发，交战双方是埃塞俄比亚皇帝达维特二世麾下的埃塞俄比亚军队，以及阿达尔苏丹国伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐率领的部队。

en.t: The Universidad Santo Tomás de Aquino is founded in what is now the Dominican Republic
en.s: The University of St. Thomas Aquinas (Spanish: Universidad de Santo Tomás de Aquino) is, from a historical perspective, the first university founded in the Americas. It was established by the papal bull In Apostolatus Culmine, issued by Pope Paul III on October 28, 1538, at a time when royal approval through a "pase regio" was not yet required.

zh.t: 圣多玛斯·阿奎那大学创立
zh.s: 从历史角度看，圣多玛斯·阿奎那大学（Universidad de Santo Tomás de Aquino）是美洲最早创立的大学。1538年10月28日，教宗保禄三世颁布教宗诏书《In Apostolatus Culmine》，该校由此成立；当时尚不要求获得王室批准（pase regio）。

en.s: The Battle of Corrichie, also known as the Battle of Corrichy was a Scottish clan battle fought near Meikle Tap, near Aberdeen, on 28 October 1562. It was fought between the forces of George Gordon, 4th Earl of Huntly, chief of Clan Gordon against the forces of Mary, Queen of Scots under James Stewart, 1st Earl of Moray. George Gordon had defeated the English twenty years earlier at the Battle of Haddon Rig, however at Corrichie he was defeated by Queen Mary's forces, and apparently he died of apoplexy after his capture.

zh.s: 科里奇战役又称科里奇山战役，是1562年10月28日在苏格兰班科里附近迈克尔塔普一带发生的氏族战斗。戈登氏族首领、第四代亨特利伯爵乔治·戈登率军与苏格兰女王玛丽麾下、由第一代莫里伯爵詹姆斯·斯图尔特率领的军队交战。乔治·戈登曾在二十年前的哈登里格战役中击败英军，但在科里奇战役中败于玛丽女王的军队；他被俘后据称因中风去世。

en.s: The siege of Coevorden was a thirty-one-week siege of the city of Coevorden in the province of Drenthe by the Spanish general Francisco Verdugo during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War. The siege first commenced in October 1593, but winter and shortages of food and supplies forced the Spanish into winter quarters.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 八十年战争和英西战争期间，西班牙将军弗朗西斯科·贝尔杜戈围攻德伦特省科沃尔登城，围城长达31周。围城始于1593年10月，但冬季到来，加上粮食和物资短缺，迫使西班牙军队进入冬季营地。

en.s: The siege of La Rochelle (French: le siège de La Rochelle, or sometimes le grand siège de La Rochelle) was a result of a war between the French royal forces of King Louis XIII and the Huguenots of La Rochelle in 1627–1628. The siege marked the height of the struggle between the Catholics and the Protestants in France and French territories, and ended with a complete victory for Louis XIII and the Catholics.
en.n: French Wars of Religion: The Siege of La Rochelle ends with the surrender of the Huguenots after fourteen months.

zh.s: 拉罗谢尔围城战（法语：le siège de La Rochelle，有时也称le grand siège de La Rochelle）源于1627至1628年间法国王室军队与拉罗谢尔新教徒之间的战争。围城战是法国及其领地内天主教徒与新教徒冲突的高潮，最终路易十三和天主教一方取得完全胜利。
zh.n: 法国宗教战争期间，拉罗谢尔围城战结束；经过14个月的围困，新教徒投降。

en.s: The siege of Smolensk lasted almost a year between 1632 and 1633, when the Muscovite army besieged the Polish–Lithuanian city of Smolensk during the war named after that siege. Russian forces of over 25,000 under Mikhail Borisovich Shein began the siege of Smolensk on 28 October. The Polish garrison under Samuel Drucki-Sokoliński numbered about 3,000.

zh.s: 斯摩棱斯克围城战持续近一年，发生于1632年至1633年。莫斯科公国军队在这场以围城命名的战争期间围攻波兰立陶宛联邦城市斯摩棱斯克。1632年10月28日，米哈伊尔·鲍里索维奇·舍因率领25000多名俄军开始围城。萨穆埃尔·德鲁茨基-索科林斯基率领约3000名波兰守军防守。

en.s: The Treaty of Ripon was a truce between Charles I, King of England, and the Covenanters, a Scottish political movement, which brought a cessation of hostilities to the Second Bishops' War. The Covenanter movement had arisen in opposition to attempts by Charles, who was also King of Scotland, to reform the Church of Scotland to bring it into closer alignment with the Church of England.
en.n: The Treaty of Ripon is signed, ending the hostilities of the Second Bishops' War.

zh.s: 里彭条约是英格兰国王查理一世与苏格兰圣约派之间的停战协议，结束了第二次主教战争的敌对行动。圣约派运动起因于查理试图改革苏格兰教会，使其更接近英格兰教会；当时查理也同时是苏格兰国王。
zh.n: 里彭条约签署，第二次主教战争的敌对行动就此结束。

en.t: The Duke of York and Albany's Maritime Regiment of Foot, later to be known as the Royal Marines, is established
en.s: His Majesty's Royal Marines are the United Kingdom's special operations-capable naval infantry force and constitute one of the five fighting arms of the Royal Navy. They provide a company-sized sub-unit to the Special Forces Support Group, personnel for landing craft crews, and personnel for the Royal Navy's military bands. The Corps traces its origins to the "Duke of York and Albany's Maritime Regiment of Foot", formed on 28 October 1664.

zh.t: 约克和奥尔巴尼公爵海军陆战团成立，后发展为皇家海军陆战队
zh.s: 英国皇家海军陆战队是英国具备特种作战能力的海军步兵部队，也是皇家海军五大作战力量之一。该部队向特种部队支援群提供一个连规模的分队、登陆艇艇员，并为皇家海军军乐队提供人员。其历史可追溯至1664年10月28日成立的“约克和奥尔巴尼公爵海军陆战团”。

en.s: The Battle of Poniec took place on October 28, 1704 in Poniec, Poland, during the Great Northern War. The Swedish Army under Charles XII unsuccessfully dislodged the Saxon Army under Johann Matthias von der Schulenburg through several cavalry charges. The Saxons had deployed in a massive square formation near the village of Janiszewo, west of Poniec.

zh.s: 波涅茨战役于1704年10月28日在波兰波涅茨发生，是大北方战争的一部分。查理十二世率领的瑞典军队多次发起骑兵冲锋，但未能击退约翰·马蒂亚斯·冯·德·舒伦堡率领的萨克森军队。萨克森军在波涅茨以西的亚尼斯泽沃村附近列成大型方阵。

en.s: The 1707 Hōei earthquake (Hōei jishin 宝永地震) was a large earthquake that struck south-central Japan at 14:00 local time on October 28, 1707. It was the largest earthquake in Japanese history until the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake surpassed it. It caused moderate to severe damage throughout southwestern Honshu, Shikoku and southeastern Kyūshū. The earthquake, and the resulting destructive tsunami, caused more than 5,000 casualties. This event ruptured all of the segments of the Nankai megathrust simultaneously, the only earthquake known to have done this, with an estimated magnitude of 8.6 ML. It might also have triggered the last eruption of Mount Fuji 49 days later.

zh.s: 1707年宝永地震（宝永地震，Hōei jishin）于1707年10月28日当地时间14时袭击日本中南部。在2011年东北地方太平洋近海地震发生前，这是日本历史上规模最大的地震。地震在本州西南部、四国和九州东南部造成中度至严重破坏；地震及随后发生的海啸导致5000多人遇难。此次地震同时震裂了南海海槽的所有区段，是已知唯一一次发生这种情况的地震，估算震级为8.6 ML。它也可能引发了49天后富士山的最后一次喷发。

en.t: The novel Gulliver's Travels written by Jonathan Swift is published
en.s: Gulliver's Travels, originally titled Travels into Several Remote Nations of the World. In Four Parts. By Lemuel Gulliver, First a Surgeon, and then a Captain of Several Ships, is a 1726 satirical prose novel by the Anglo-Irish writer and clergyman Jonathan Swift. It is one of the most famous classics of both English and world literature, and popularised the fictional island of Lilliput.

zh.t: 乔纳森·斯威夫特出版小说《格列佛游记》
zh.s: 《格列佛游记》原名《利米尔·格列佛船长游历世界各偏远国家记，全四部；格列佛先为外科医生，后任多艘船只的船长》，是英爱作家兼牧师乔纳森·斯威夫特于1726年出版的一部讽刺散文小说。它是英国乃至世界文学中最著名的经典作品之一，也让虚构岛屿小人国广为人知。

en.s: The siege of Kehl (14–28 October 1733) was one of the opening moves of the French Rhineland campaign in the War of the Polish Succession, at the fortress town of Kehl in the upper Rhine River valley in the Holy Roman Empire. A large French army under the command of the Duke of Berwick besieged and captured the fortress, which was lightly garrisoned and in poor condition.

zh.s: 凯尔围城战于1733年10月14日至28日进行，是波兰王位继承战争期间法国莱茵兰战役的开端行动之一，战场在神圣罗马帝国上莱茵河谷的要塞城镇凯尔。贝里克公爵率领大批法军围攻并攻占要塞；守军人数不多，要塞状况也很差。

en.s: The 1746 Lima–Callao earthquake occurred at 22:30 local time on 28 October with a moment magnitude of 8.6–8.8 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of XI (Extreme). The epicenter was located about 90 km (56 mi) north-northwest of the capital Lima, which was almost completely destroyed, and the subsequent tsunami devastated the port city of Callao. It was the deadliest earthquake in Peru's history prior to the 1970 earthquake.
en.n: The 1746 Lima–Callao earthquake causes up to 6,000 deaths in Peru, the deadliest in its history up to that point.

zh.s: 1746年10月28日当地时间22时30分，利马—卡亚俄发生地震，矩震级为8.6至8.8级，最高烈度达麦加利烈度XI级（极强）。震中位于首都利马以北偏西北约90公里处，利马几乎被完全摧毁；随后的海啸也重创港口城市卡亚俄。在1970年地震发生前，这是秘鲁历史上伤亡最惨重的地震。
zh.n: 地震造成秘鲁多达6000人死亡，是当时秘鲁历史上伤亡最惨重的地震。

en.s: The Battle of White Plains took place during the New York and New Jersey campaign of the American Revolutionary War on October 28, 1776, near White Plains, New York. Following the retreat of George Washington's Continental Army northward from New York City, British General William Howe landed troops in Westchester County, intending to cut off Washington's escape route.

zh.s: 怀特普莱恩斯战役于1776年10月28日在美国纽约州怀特普莱恩斯附近爆发，是美国独立战争纽约—新泽西战役的一部分。乔治·华盛顿率领的大陆军从纽约市向北撤退后，英国将军威廉·豪在威彻斯特县登陆，意图切断华盛顿的退路。

en.s: The 1785 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on October 28, 1785, in order to elect the Governor of New Jersey. Incumbent Governor William Livingston was re-elected by the New Jersey General Assembly against his opponent candidate David Brearley.

zh.s: 新泽西州于1785年10月28日举行州长选举。现任州长威廉·利文斯顿在州议会选举中击败对手戴维·布里尔利，成功连任。

en.s: The Siege of Koppal (28 October 1790 – 7 April 1791) was conducted during the Third Anglo-Mysore War by forces of the Nizam of Hyderabad under the command of Mahabat Jung, assisted by a contingent of British East India Company forces. The siege was poorly conducted, and the garrison surrendered principally because Bangalore had fallen in February 1791. zh.s: 科帕尔围城战发生于1790年10月28日至1791年4月7日，是第三次英迈战争的一部分。海得拉巴尼扎姆的军队在马哈巴特·章指挥下作战，并得到英国东印度公司的部分部队协助。围城指挥不力，守军主要因班加罗尔于1791年2月失守而投降。

But both received the same number of votes from the New Jersey General Assembly, resulting in a deadlocked election.

en.s: In the Battle of Prenzlau or Capitulation of Prenzlau on 28 October 1806 two divisions of French cavalry and some infantry led by Marshal Joachim Murat intercepted a retreating Prussian corps led by Frederick Louis, Prince of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen. In this action from the War of the Fourth Coalition, Hohenlohe surrendered his entire force to Murat after some fighting and a parley. Prenzlau is located about 90 kilometers north of Berlin in Brandenburg, Germany at the intersection of routes B109 and B198. After their catastrophic defeat at the Battle of Jena-Auerstedt on 14 October, the Prussian armies fled north to the Elbe River with Emperor Napoleon I of France's victorious army in hot pursuit.

zh.s: 1806年10月28日，法军缪拉元帅率两支骑兵师和部分步兵，在普伦茨劳截住由霍恩洛厄-英格尔芬根亲王弗里德里希·路易率领的普军撤退部队。这场第四次反法同盟战争中的战斗也称普伦茨劳投降事件。双方交战并谈判后，霍恩洛厄将全军交给缪拉。普伦茨劳位于德国勃兰登堡州，柏林以北约90公里，处在B109和B198公路交会处。10月14日耶拿—奥尔施泰特战役惨败后，普军向北逃往易北河，法国皇帝拿破仑一世的胜利之师紧追不舍。

en.s: The Battle of Arroyo dos Molinos took place on 28 October 1811 during the Peninsular War. An allied force under General Rowland Hill trapped and defeated a French force under General Jean-Baptiste Girard, forcing the latter's dismissal by the Emperor Napoleon. A whole French infantry division and a brigade of cavalry were destroyed as viable fighting formations.

zh.t: 阿罗约多斯莫利诺斯战役
zh.s: 阿罗约多斯莫利诺斯战役于1811年10月28日在半岛战争期间爆发。罗兰·希尔将军率领的盟军包围并击败了让-巴蒂斯特·吉拉尔将军率领的法军，迫使拿破仑皇帝撤销吉拉尔的职务。一整个法国步兵师和一个骑兵旅作为有效作战部队被歼灭。

en.s: The Capture of Orizaba was a battle of the War of Mexican Independence that occurred on 28 October 1812 at Orizaba, Veracruz. The battle was fought between the royalist forces loyal to the Spanish crown, commanded by General José Antonio Andrade, and the Mexican rebels fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire, commanded by José María Morelos y Pavón. The battle resulted in a victory for the Mexican rebels.

zh.s: 奥里萨瓦攻占战是墨西哥独立战争中的一场战斗，于1812年10月28日在韦拉克鲁斯州奥里萨瓦发生。效忠西班牙王室的保皇派军队由何塞·安东尼奥·安德拉德将军指挥；争取脱离西班牙帝国独立的墨西哥起义军由何塞·玛丽亚·莫雷洛斯·帕翁指挥。战斗以墨西哥起义军获胜告终。

en.s: The Battle of Venta de Echavarri (Spanish: Acción de la Venta de Echavarri or Batalla de la Venta de Echavarri, literally the Battle of the Inn of Echavarri), a battle of the First Carlist War, occurred on October 28, 1834. It was an immediate follow-up to the Battle of Alegría de Álava, which had occurred the day before. It was a Carlist victory.

zh.s: 埃查瓦里旅店战役是第一次卡洛斯战争中的一场战斗，发生于1834年10月28日。该战役紧接前一天发生的阿莱格里亚-德阿拉瓦战役，最终由卡洛斯派获胜。

en.s: The Pinjarra massacre, in the past called the Battle of Pinjarra, occurred on 28 October 1834 in Pinjarra, Western Australia when a group of Bindjareb Noongar people were attacked by a detachment of 25 soldiers, police, and settlers led by Governor James Stirling. According to Stirling, "about 60 or 70" of the Bindjareb people were present at the camp and John Roe, who also participated, estimated about 70–80.

zh.s: 平贾拉大屠杀过去也称平贾拉战役，于1834年10月28日在西澳大利亚州平贾拉发生。一支由州长詹姆斯·斯特灵率领、由25名士兵、警察和定居者组成的队伍袭击了宾贾雷布努恩加人。斯特灵称营地里“约有60或70人”；同样参与袭击的约翰·罗估计人数约为70至80人。

en.s: The Battle of the Virilla River was a battle fought on 28 October 1835 on the western bank of the Virilla River, in the context of the League War, the second Costa Rican civil war. It opposed the main League army, composed of combined forces from Heredia and Alajuela, against the militia of San José.

zh.s: 维里利亚河战役于1835年10月28日在维里利亚河西岸爆发，属于第二次哥斯达黎加内战“联盟战争”的一部分。交战双方为由埃雷迪亚和阿拉胡埃拉联合组成的联盟军主力，以及圣何塞民兵。

en.t: Expedition of William Walker to Baja California and Sonora
en.s: William Walker's expedition to Baja California and Sonora was an unauthorized armed incursion by the American adventurer William Walker and a small force of filibusters into Mexican territory. Motivated by Manifest destiny, personal ambition, and the expansionist politics of the late antebellum United States, Walker tried to seize the sparsely populated Baja California Territory as a base from which to take Sonora and proclaim them an independent republic as a prelude to possible annexation by the United States.

zh.s: 威廉·沃克远征下加利福尼亚和索诺拉，是美国冒险家威廉·沃克率领一小队雇佣兵未经授权进入墨西哥领土发动的武装入侵。沃克受“昭昭天命”观念、个人野心以及美国内战前扩张主义政治影响，试图夺取人口稀少的下加利福尼亚地区，将其作为攻取索诺拉的基地，并宣布两地成立独立共和国，为日后可能并入美国做准备。

en.s: The Battle of McGuire's Store (28 October 1862) was fought at McGuire, Arkansas, near Elkins, between Union forces led by Brigadier General Francis J. Herron and Confederate forces under Colonel Jesse L. Cravens during the American Civil War. The skirmish was the result of an attempt by Union Brigadier General John Schofield to trap a body of Confederate cavalry reported to be at McGuire's Store.

zh.s: 麦奎尔商店战役于1862年10月28日在美国内战期间发生，地点位于阿肯色州麦奎尔、埃尔金斯附近。联邦军由弗朗西斯·J·赫伦准将率领，南方邦联军由杰西·L·克雷文斯上校率领。此次小规模交战源于联邦军约翰·斯科菲尔德准将试图包围一支据报驻扎在麦奎尔商店的南方邦联骑兵部队。

en.s: The Battle of Wauhatchie was fought October 28–29, 1863, in Hamilton and Marion Counties, Tennessee, and Dade County, Georgia, in the American Civil War. A Union force had seized Brown's Ferry on the Tennessee River, opening a supply line to the Union army in Chattanooga. Confederate forces attempted to dislodge the Union force defending the ferry and again close this supply line but were defeated.

zh.s: 沃哈奇战役于1863年10月28日至29日在美国内战期间进行，战场横跨田纳西州汉密尔顿县和马里恩县，以及佐治亚州戴德县。联邦军夺取田纳西河上的布朗渡口，打通了通往查塔努加联邦军的补给线。南方邦联军试图赶走守卫渡口的联邦军，再次切断这条补给线，但被击败。

en.s: The Second Battle of Newtonia was fought on October 28, 1864, in Newton County, Missouri, as part of Major General Sterling Price's Missouri Expedition of the American Civil War. Price's Confederate cavalry force was in full retreat following its expedition into Missouri. On October 28, 1864, it stopped to rest about two miles (3 km) south of Newtonia, Missouri. About 3:00 p.m., Maj. Gen. James G. Blunt's Union cavalrymen spotted the rear of Price’s supply train entering the woods south of town on the Cassville road. McLain's Colorado Light Artillery, supported by the 15th Kansas Cavalry, opened on the rebels.

zh.s: 第二次牛顿尼亚战役于1864年10月28日在密苏里州牛顿县发生，是美国内战期间斯特林·普莱斯少将密苏里远征的一部分。普莱斯率领的南方邦联骑兵部队在密苏里远征后全面撤退，途中停在密苏里州牛顿尼亚以南约2英里（3公里）处休整。下午约3时，詹姆斯·G·布朗特少将率领的联邦骑兵发现普莱斯的辎重队尾部正沿卡斯维尔公路进入镇南树林。麦克莱恩科罗拉多轻炮兵在第15堪萨斯骑兵支援下向南方邦联军开火。

en.s: The Battle of Ladiga, also known as the Battle of Terrapin Creek, was fought on October 28, 1864, near Ladiga, Alabama, during the American Civil War. The last of the fighting between the armies of generals John B. Hood and William T. Sherman, it was here that Confederate Brigadier-General Samuel W. Ferguson turned back Brigadier-General Kenner Garrard's larger force.

zh.s: 拉迪加战役又称特拉平溪战役，于1864年10月28日在美国内战期间、阿拉巴马州拉迪加附近发生。这是约翰·B·胡德将军与威廉·T·谢尔曼将军两军之间最后一场战斗。南方邦联准将塞缪尔·W·弗格森在此击退了兵力更多的联邦准将肯纳·加勒德所部。

en.s: The Battle of Morristown took place during the American Civil War in present-day Hamblen County, Tennessee on October 28, 1864. Union forces under General Alvan C. Gillem attacked Confederate forces under General John C. Vaughn who were defending Morristown, Tennessee. Vaughn's Confederates were routed and Gillem's forces pursued them into nearby Russellville, Tennessee.

zh.s: 莫里斯敦战役于1864年10月28日在美国内战期间发生，地点在今田纳西州汉布伦县。阿尔文·C·吉勒姆将军率领联邦军进攻约翰·C·沃恩将军率领、负责防守田纳西州莫里斯敦的南方邦联军。沃恩所部溃败，吉勒姆的部队追击至附近的田纳西州拉塞尔维尔。

en.t: Battle of Fair Oaks & Darbytown Road
en.s: The Battle of Fair Oaks & Darbytown Road (also known as the Second Battle of Fair Oaks) was fought on October 27–28, 1864, in Henrico County, Virginia, as part of the Richmond-Petersburg Campaign of the American Civil War. In combination with movements against the Boydton Plank Road at Petersburg, Maj. Gen. Benjamin Butler attacked the Richmond defenses along Darbytown Road with the X Corps.

en.s: The Battle of Potrero Obella was a battle between a Paraguayan Army of 300 against 5,000 Brazilians. Although the Paraguayans took heavy losses, they inflicted 395 casualties (85 killed, 310 wounded) on the Brazilians. Brazilian Gen. Barreto was sent from Villa del Pillar to capture Tayi on the River Paraguay, and Potrero Ovello on 27 October 1867. This would enable a Brazilian blockade of the Paraguayan garrisons.

zh.t: 波特雷罗奥贝利亚之战
zh.s: 波特雷罗奥贝利亚之战中，300名巴拉圭士兵与5,000名巴西士兵交战。巴拉圭军队损失惨重，但也造成巴西军395人伤亡，其中85人死亡、310人受伤。1867年10月27日，巴西将军巴雷托奉命从比利亚德尔皮拉尔出发，攻取巴拉圭河上的塔伊和波特雷罗奥韦略，以便封锁巴拉圭驻军。

en.s: The Hagi Rebellion (萩の乱, Hagi no ran) was an uprising against the Meiji government of Japan that occurred in Hagi from 28 October 1876 to 5 November 1876. Maebara Issei, a disillusioned hero of the Meiji Restoration and former samurai of the Chōshū Domain, planned an attack on Yamaguchi Prefecture officials inspired by the Shinpūren rebellion four days earlier.

zh.s: 萩之乱（萩の乱，Hagi no ran）是反对日本明治政府的一场起义，于1876年10月28日至11月5日在萩发生。明治维新功臣、前长州藩武士前原一诚心怀失望，受四天前的神风连之乱鼓舞，策划袭击山口县官员。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 14 and 28 October 1877 to elect members of the Chamber of Deputies. They were held during the Seize Mai crisis. President Patrice de MacMahon dissolved the Chamber of Deputies elected in 1876, in the hope of a conservative and royalist victory. Although royalists lost seats, Bonapartists increased their seat total over 1876; the Republicans lost 80 seats, but retained a majority.

zh.s: 法国于1877年10月14日和28日举行立法选举，选出众议院议员。选举期间正值“五月十六日危机”。总统帕特里斯·德·麦克马洪解散了1876年选出的众议院，希望保守派和保皇派获胜。尽管保皇派失去席位，波拿巴派比1876年多获席位；共和派失去80席，但仍保住多数。

en.s: The 1897 Newfoundland general election was held on October 28, 1897 to elect members of the 18th General Assembly of Newfoundland. The Conservative Party led by James Spearman Winter formed the government. On February 15, 1900, the government was defeated following a vote on a motion of no confidence which was supported by the Liberals and several Tories.

zh.s: 纽芬兰于1897年10月28日举行大选，选出第18届纽芬兰议会的议员。詹姆斯·斯皮尔曼·温特领导的保守党组建政府。1900年2月15日，在自由党和数名保守党议员支持的不信任动议表决中，政府被击败。

en.s: The battle of Kouno was an inconclusive battle that took place between French troops and the Muslim army led by Rabih az-Zubayr, in the context of French colonial expansion in Africa, and more precisely in Chad. On August 16, 1899 the leader of the Gentil Mission, the Captain Émile Gentil, was informed of the utter annihilation by the warlord Rabih az-Zubayr of the Bretonnet-Braun Mission at Togbao on July 17.

en.s: General elections were held in Tanzania on 28 October 1990. The country was a one-party state at the time, with the Chama Cha Mapinduzi as the sole legal party. en.s: The Ukrainian parliamentary election of 2012 took place on 28 October 2012. Because of various reasons, including the "impossibility of announcing election results" various by-elections have taken place since. Hence, several constituencies have been left unrepresented at various times. Unlike the two previous elections, this election used a mixed voting system (50% under party lists and 50% under simple-majority constituencies) with a 5% election threshold and the participation of blocs of political parties was not allowed any more. The method of 50/50 mixed elections was used previously in 1998 and 2002. The election campaign was limited to 90 days.

The election was competed by ten candidates from newly reshuffled political alliances, and is expected to be an unusually close race. The winner of the election was Rosario Crocetta, candidate for a centre-left alliance of Democratic Party and the Union of the Centre.

en.s: The Afar–Somali clashes were territorial conflicts between the Afar and Somali Regions of Ethiopia. The current conflict which began in 2014, is centered around three special Kebeles inhabited by ethnic Somalis from the Issa Clan. These three special Kebeles include the Adaytu (Afar: Qadaytu, Somali: Cadayto) in Mille woreda, Undufo (Afar: Qundafaqo, Somali: Cundhufo) in Gewane woreda, and Gedamaytu (Afar: Gadamaytu, Somali: Garba-Ciise) in Amibara Woreda.

en.s: The 2022 Egyptian Super Cup was the 19th Egyptian Super Cup, an annual football match between the winners of the previous season's Egyptian Premier League and Egypt Cup. en.s: The 2023 Copa Sudamericana final was the final match which decided the winner of the 2023 Copa Sudamericana. en.s: Hurricane Melissa was an extremely powerful tropical cyclone that made a catastrophic landfall in Jamaica in late October 2025. By maximum sustained winds, it is tied with Hurricane Allen as the strongest Atlantic hurricane, and with Hurricane Dorian and the 1935 Labor Day hurricane as the strongest landfalling Atlantic hurricane. Allen and Melissa are the only Atlantic hurricanes to attain maximum sustained winds of 190 mph (305 km/h).
en.n: Hurricane Melissa makes landfall near Black River, Jamaica, killing over 30 people, as well as tying the 1935 Labor Day hurricane as the most intense landfall in the North Atlantic.

zh.s: 飓风梅丽莎是一个极其强大的热带气旋，于2025年10月下旬在牙买加灾难性登陆。按最大持续风速计算，它与飓风艾伦并列为大西洋最强飓风，也与飓风多里安及1935年劳动节飓风并列为登陆时最强的大西洋飓风。艾伦和梅丽莎是仅有的最大持续风速达到每小时190英里（305公里）的两场大西洋飓风。
zh.n: 飓风梅丽莎在牙买加布莱克河附近登陆，造成30多人死亡；其登陆强度也与1935年劳动节飓风并列为北大西洋最强。
